items.description:
VITZ Travel and Tours is a Centurion-based tour and transfer operator offering guided excursions around Gauteng and further afield, including a private surface and underground tour of the Cullinan Diamond Mine, visits to Pretoria City, and journeys to destinations such as Soweto, the Cradle of Humankind and the Apartheid Museum. The underground mine tour does not permit children under ten.

The company's fleet includes a Mercedes-Benz C-Class for smaller, intimate trips and a Mercedes-Benz Vito for group travel, both air-conditioned, which it pairs with its guided tour packages and airport transfers. Its newsletter shares travel stories and tips on hidden gems and cultural sites around the country. It suits visitors and local travellers who want a guided day out or a reliable transfer in comfort, and the business operates from Brooklands Lifestyle Estate, Centurion.

Vonk Creative Solutions designs and manufactures loadbin racks and industrial rack accessories for bakkies in Weavind Park, Pretoria. Its range covers Supercab, Double Cab, Highrise and custom loadbin racks, along with bridge kits that include three bridge pieces with loadbin mounting brackets, built to carry a roof-top tent or other accessories.

Each rack is designed on 3D CAD, cut and bent on CNC laser equipment, and finished with a charcoal-textured powder coating over Docol 1200 main slats. The racks are built for a completely bolt-on, kit-form installation, and several models are designed to work with a KEKO tonneau cover. The company says it is always open to product upgrades, accessories and one-off parts for a customer's needs. It suits bakkie owners who want a strong, tailored load-carrying setup, and the workshop is on Cresswell Road in Weavind Park.

Warp Development is a technology consulting and software development firm based at The Willows in Pretoria, with 24 years building technology for clients in South Africa, the United States, Europe and Australia. Its AI consulting covers autonomous agents, content generation, enterprise search, productivity copilots, business automation and machine-learning forecasting, aimed at moving AI work beyond a proof of concept.

Its enterprise software development covers full-stack development, system integration, platform and product development and legacy modernisation, while its IT infrastructure and managed services keep a business's systems secure and stable. The firm also offers staff augmentation for teams that need extra capacity. It suits businesses that want one partner across AI, software and infrastructure rather than separate providers for each, and the office is at the Fintech Campus on Botterklapper and Illanga Road.

items.reason: Follow-up research confirms the RO Water / Water Shop brand (RO water systems, water filters and filtration components, serving households and businesses) has a general Centurion/Eco Park presence, but no source could independently verify the specific branch at Shop 9B, 270 Eco Park Road; chain-level facts alone are still not enough for a branch listing.

items.description:
Waterfalls Boutique Hotel is a boutique guest house set high on the mountain in Waterkloof, Pretoria, with views over the city and its lights at night. The property offers standard, luxury, superior king and honeymoon suite configurations, giving guests elegance, comfort and privacy, along with tranquil gardens, an outdoor pool and a hot tub.

An in-house restaurant caters for romantic and business dinners, serving quality meals with a selection of alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, and the hotel offers extra romantic services on request for guests marking a special occasion. The establishment positions itself as a more private and relaxed alternative to a typical guest house or hotel, aimed at the professional traveller. It suits couples, business travellers and anyone wanting an exclusive stay away from the everyday hotel experience, and the hotel is in Waterkloof Park, Pretoria.

Waterplaas Elarduspark is a branch of the Waterplaas water-shop franchise, which operates more than 30 outlets across South Africa. The Elarduspark store sells water on tap and bottled water along with containers, and is part of a chain that also stocks locally sourced products such as Big B Atchar and Waterplaas Spices.

The business says it is committed to providing the highest quality of water, with every bottle prepared with care so customers can trust what they are drinking. It suits households and businesses in Pretoria East who want a nearby refill point for clean drinking water alongside a few pantry extras. The branch is on Alouette Street in Elarduspark, Pretoria East.

Wierda Park Butchery is a butchery in Centurion trading since 1976, supplying beef, lamb, pork, chicken, boerewors, cold meats, bacon and fish. Its steaks are dry-aged and vacuum packed alongside other prime cuts to develop fullness of flavour and tenderness, and all its processed products are made with Class A meat and no added fillers.

The shop also stocks pantry items, marinades and spices, braai accessories, jams and meat hampers, and it processes game meat over the May to August hunting season. It rents out spit braais for functions, including a full lamb on the spit, and describes itself as offering a friendly, clean and hygienic shopping experience for the whole family. It suits households stocking up for a braai and anyone planning a function that needs a spit, and the butchery is on Springbok Street in Wierdapark.

Yellow Pocket is a graphic and website design business in Hazeldean, Pretoria, offering multimedia solutions for small, medium and large companies. Its website packages include a basic site with three to five pages, free domain registration and free hosting for the first year, and the company also builds ecommerce and content-managed websites.

Its graphic design work covers logo design, with two initial options and a set of revisions, and company profile design with cover, back cover and internal page layouts supplied print- and email-ready. Beyond design, the team produces animation and video content and offers web hosting. It suits start-ups and growing businesses that want a web presence built and supported in one place, and the business is on Silverlakes Road in Hazeldean.

A Bach Waste Management provides waste removal and recycling services from its base in Bon Accord, Pretoria, with more than 16 years of experience since 2008. Its services include wheelie bin collection for general, food and special waste, skip bin hire for commercial waste, building rubble, garden waste and hazardous waste, and on-site recycling with recycling and waste reports.

The company also offers confidential document disposal and safe disposal certificates for waste that must be disposed of responsibly, and it serves shopping centres, business parks, residential estates and commercial and industrial clients. It describes its mission as creating cleaner, more sustainable environments through reliable, professional and eco-friendly waste management. It suits property managers and businesses across Pretoria and Johannesburg that need a dependable waste partner, and the company is based on Rivier Street in Bon Accord.

A & H Wendy Houses is a premium manufacturer of wooden Wendy houses, based from an office in Menlo Park with its factory in Boschkop, Pretoria. Its houses are built from oven-dried, graded South African pine, using 15mm tongue and groove construction with sturdy wooden floors and glass-fitted windows, and roofs finished in fibre cement or galvanised corrugated iron.

The company uses ringshank nails rather than ordinary wire nails for a stronger build, and it offers to remove an existing Wendy house free of charge when installing a new one. Installations run across Pretoria, Centurion, Midrand, Johannesburg and as far as Rustenburg, with depots for viewing in Montana, Centurion and Faerie Glen. It suits homeowners who want a durable Wendy house or guard hut built to last, and the business also supplies customers in Gauteng towns including Brakpan, Boksburg and Vereeniging.

Absolute Solar Solutions is part of the Absolute Chilled Group, an air conditioning and energy solutions company established over 22 years ago and based in Centurion. The group is structured into divisions covering air conditioning, heating solutions, solar energy and water backup systems, supplying, installing, repairing and maintaining products from established brands for residential and commercial clients.

The group operates extensively across Gauteng and beyond from its Centurion office, and its leadership has built a reputation for quality and reliability over more than two decades. As the solar division of this group, Absolute Solar Solutions draws on that same nationwide reach and technical support structure for its installations. It suits homeowners and businesses looking for a solar partner backed by a larger, established energy services group, and the office is on Johannes Drive in Hennopspark, Centurion.

Accolades Decor is a wedding and event décor company in Elardus Park, Pretoria, offering both full styling services and rental-only hire of individual pieces. Its ceremony range includes arches, bird cages, carpets, Chinese lanterns and decorative flowers, while its reception range covers cake stands, candle holders, centrepieces, cutlery, draping, glasses, mirrors, napkins, table cloths, table names and numbers, and underplates.

The company's services are split between décor styling, where the team designs and sets up the full look, and rental-only hire for clients who want to handle their own styling, plus a separate offering for functions and corporate events. Its online shop and gallery let clients browse the full product range before booking. It suits couples and event planners who want either a complete styling service or individual décor pieces to hire, and the business has worked in weddings and events since 2010 from its Elardus Park base.

ACDC Express Centurion is an electrical retail store in Miracle Retail Park on Lenchen Avenue, Rooihuiskraal North, part of the ACDC Express franchise network and sourcing stock from ACDC Dynamics. The store sells tools, solar equipment, home automation gear, switchgear, cabling and general electrical accessories, with current promotions including a premium solar combo and rechargeable, colour-selectable lighting.

As part of a national franchise, the branch is backed by group policies covering returns and refunds, surge protection and battery warranties, and customers can track orders and manage accounts online or in-store. The company also runs a newsletter with specials and competitions, and offers franchise opportunities to prospective store owners. It suits electricians, contractors and DIY customers who want electrical and solar supplies from a trusted franchise, and the store is in Rooihuiskraal North, Centurion.

Advanced Printer-Ink Technologies is a printer and copier consumables supplier at Madelief Centre in Dorandia, Pretoria, with more than 15 years in the trade. The shop supplies original and generic ink and toner cartridges for brands including Benchmark, HP, Brother, Canon, Lexmark, Samsung, Epson, Xerox, Ricoh, RISO, Duplo, Kyocera Mita, Olivetti, OKI, Panasonic and Konica Minolta.

Beyond consumables, the business offers new printer sales, printer maintenance and printer repairs, servicing most brands so a faulty machine does not have to be replaced. Its customer base includes corporates, schools, small businesses and home users, and it offers free delivery to most areas of Pretoria. It suits offices and households that want competitive pricing and reliable service on printer supplies and repairs, and the shop is on the corner of Daan de Wet Nel Drive and Bokmakierie Street in Dorandia.

items.description:
This Aldes Business Broker office, trading as Aldes Infinity, is based in Centurion and specialises in helping clients buy and sell small and medium businesses. Its broker holds a post-graduate diploma in financial planning, is a practising independent certified financial planner, and spent years structuring large institutional investments at a major bank before moving into business broking.

Through the wider Aldes network, clients can discover businesses for sale, list their own business for sale, or find opportunities through auction, and the brokerage covers a range of sectors and price points from established trades to small retail concerns. The service includes guidance on valuation and structuring a sale so that both buyer and seller reach a fair deal. It suits business owners planning an exit and buyers looking for an established business to acquire, and the office is at Midlands Office Park in Midstream, Midrand.

Alectra Solutions is a security and automation products shop in Pretoria, describing itself as the company's flagship store and stocking gate motors, gate motor parts, batteries, garage motors and doors, electric fencing, CCTV systems, intercoms, electrical and cabling items and LP gas. Customers can shop in categories such as remotes, with dozens of products listed in several ranges including Centurion Systems, E.T and DigiDoor.

The store supplies products rather than performing installations, with courier delivery available nationwide for a flat rate on smaller orders, and free collection from its Pretoria branches. It offers genuine stock backed by supplier warranties, and the company says a real person answers enquiries on WhatsApp for advice before a purchase. It suits homeowners and trade installers who want security and gate automation parts with local stock and support, and the business has operated since 2012 from Wonderboom, Pretoria.

Own site continues to fail to resolve (DNS error), and search results keep surfacing only pages about Amalfi, Italy; rooms, facilities, rating and operating status remain unconfirmed.

items.description:
Amalgamated Technical Services, known as ATS Africa, is a Pretoria-based group of specialised industrial services companies formed in response to the challenges small businesses faced during the Covid-19 pandemic. The group brings together specialist firms under one structure, offering industrial rope access work, high access painting and waterproofing, anchor point installation and certification, life line installation and certification, commercial facilities maintenance and solar installation.

Its rope access teams are certified technicians equipped to handle complex access challenges in construction, mining and petrochemical settings, while its total facilities maintenance service covers ongoing building upkeep for commercial clients. The group says it was built to pool the strengths of several specialised enterprises into one dependable partner across Africa. It suits construction, mining and industrial clients needing specialised access, maintenance or coating work, and the office is on Justice Mahomed Street in Muckleneuk, Pretoria.

Amchem is a raw-material supplier based in Southdowns, Centurion, serving the pharmaceutical, nutrition, personal care, industrial, healthcare and animal health industries. Its product portfolio includes petroleum jelly in BP/USP white and yellow grades, pharmaceutical white oil, microcrystalline and paraffin wax, lanolin in anhydrous and hydrogenated forms, mono propylene glycol, glycerine and stearic acid, supplied in pack sizes from 15kg drums up to bulk road tankers.

The company operates three warehousing facilities, in Durban, Cape Town and Johannesburg, which lets it service customers nationwide and beyond South Africa's borders. Its approach is built on close relationships across its entire supply chain, from principal suppliers through to the industries it serves. It suits manufacturers in these industries who need a dependable source of bulk raw materials with national distribution, and the Centurion office is on Clover Street in Southdowns.

This practice is run by a counselling psychologist registered and listed on the Medpages healthcare database under the Lynnwood, Pretoria area. The listing identifies the practice under the specialism of counselling psychology, placed within the City of Tshwane Metropolitan Municipality in Gauteng.

Medpages is a public directory of healthcare providers operated by IQVIA, and the practice's listing forms part of that wider database used by patients to find registered mental health professionals in their area. The practice falls under the broader category of mental health professionals, alongside other psychologists listed in the same database. It suits residents of the Lynnwood and greater Pretoria area who are looking for a registered counselling psychologist close to home, with the practice based on Alkantrant Road.

ANM Accountants is an accounting and tax practice with offices in Centurion and Lenasia, offering accounting, BEE certification, company registration, payroll, taxation, trust administration, and tax and statutory registrations, including beneficial ownership filings. Its Eldoraigne office trades from the QPS Building on Henri Road.

The firm's company registration service is run as a fixed-price offering, with packages ranging from a company-only registration through to a VAT accounting package, each including free accounting advice from a qualified chartered accountant after registration. Packages can include tax clearance certificates, BEE certificates or affidavits, CSD and CIDB registration for construction clients, and the first year's financial statements. It suits small and growing businesses that want their registration, tax and accounting handled by one chartered accounting firm, and the Eldoraigne office is on Henri Road, Centurion.

ANM Accountants - Small Business Accounting and Tax Solutions is the Eldoraigne office of ANM Accountants, based on Saxby Road in Centurion, offering tax planning, VAT guidance, payroll and company registration support to small businesses. Its company registration service is run as a set of fixed-price packages, from a company-only registration through to a full VAT accounting package.

Each package can include a company name of choice where available at CIPC, income tax registration, a tax clearance certificate, a BEE certificate or affidavit, a share certificate, CSD registration, and submission of income tax and VAT returns, with the VAT accounting package covering a full year of support. The firm positions itself as a legitimate chartered accountants practice offering free accounting advice after registration. It suits new and small businesses that want registration and ongoing tax and accounting support in one place, and the office is at 997 Saxby Road, Eldoraigne.

items.description:
Apostil is a privately owned document concierge company in Muckleneuk, Pretoria, assisting South Africans at home and abroad with apostilles, police clearances, Home Affairs documents and travel visas. The company queues and applies for documents on a client's behalf and then couriers the finished paperwork to them, saving clients from standing in line themselves.

Its accredited team includes officially registered marriage officers, registered notaries, genealogical researchers and former VFS visa assistants, with representation at all 14 High Courts of South Africa. Services include apostilles obtained at DIRCO in Pretoria, academic certificate verification, High Court authentications, sworn translations and expungements, and health certificate verification. The company is clear that it is not a government department, but a private firm representing clients in these processes. It suits South Africans who need travel, investment, immigration or visa documents handled quickly, and the office is at Walker Creek Office Park on Florence Ribeiro Avenue.

items.description:
Aqua Pura Water Refill and Filter is a water purification and refill business trading from the Waterkloof Rand Centre at the corner of Rigel Avenue and Buffelsdrift Street in Erasmusrand. Its online catalogue lists reverse osmosis systems for the home, ranging from 100 gallon-per-day units with or without a pump up to larger 400, 600 and 800 gallon-per-day systems, alongside sediment filter cartridges and other filtration parts.

The business offers water refills from its premises, and its site promotes a rate of R1 per litre for refills alongside its equipment sales. Customers can get a free quote on a home reverse osmosis system before buying, and the product range covers both replacement parts for existing systems and complete new installations. It suits households and small businesses in the Waterkloof Rand and Erasmusrand area that want affordable purified water on tap or a home filtration system installed.

Arte Construction, trading as Arte Architects, is a South African architectural practice with studios in Centurion and Gauteng, founded in 2014. Decades of combined experience in architecture and construction came together under its founders, and the office, led by a small team of architects, designs contemporary residential homes, lodges and hospitality buildings and multi-residential developments.

The practice is dedicated to innovative, practical and sustainable design, aiming for buildings that are energy efficient and environmentally sensitive while remaining elegant and timeless. Clients are shown interactive, realistic 3D presentations of their dream property alongside detailed construction drawings, which the firm says gives an unsurpassed experience before building begins. It suits families, individuals and companies who want an all-in-one architecture and construction service, and the office is at Cornwall Hill Country Estate in Centurion.

Atlas Finance is a financial services provider with a branch at Eastside Plaza in East Lynne, Pretoria, offering personal loans as part of a network that has operated for 30 years and helped more than three million South Africans. The company was founded in 1994, after South Africa's first democratic elections, when its founder identified a gap for unsecured loans among people who had been excluded from the formal credit market.

Its first two branches opened in Johannesburg in 1994, and the group has since grown nationwide while keeping its founding goal of protecting borrowers from high-rate backstreet lenders. Loan products are designed to help cover everyday needs such as school fees, groceries, business costs and home alterations. It suits people in the East Lynne area who need a short-term loan from an established, registered lender, and the branch is at Eastside Plaza on Baviaanspoort Road.

Bageso Housing and Development Consultants is a BEE-certified pre-construction planning firm on Puzzlewood Street in Brooklands Lifestyle Estate, Centurion. Its government and corporate planning services include business plans, integrated development plans and growth strategies, strategic planning, monitoring and implementation, and systems and process implementation for public and private clients.

On the pre-construction side, the firm offers architectural design, civil and electrical engineering, environmental impact assessment, floodline engineering, geotechnical investigations, geographic information system work, land acquisition and land surveying, along with township upgrading and solar farm development support. It describes itself as an industry leader in town planning, aiming to lay the groundwork for sustainable growth. It suits municipalities, developers and businesses that need planning and pre-construction technical work from a single, BEE-certified consultancy, established in 2003.

Bakers Bin is a wholesale bakery supplies retailer founded in Pretoria in 1999, trading from Shop 25 in Lynnridge Mall, Lynnwood Ridge. The business distributes baking ingredients, pre-mixes, decorations and equipment to bakeries, restaurants, cafes and home bakers, supplying the materials behind both commercial baking operations and smaller home-based businesses.

As a wholesaler, Bakers Bin positions its range to suit buyers who need ingredients and equipment in bulk rather than single retail packs, serving the food and bakery trade across the Lynnwood Ridge area. It suits bakeries, cafes, restaurants and serious home bakers who want a reliable wholesale source for pre-mixes, decorations and baking equipment, and the store is reachable directly at Lynnridge Mall on the corner of Lynnwood Road and Jacobson Drive.

The Bank of Lisbon Building is a commercial office building of roughly 15,000 square metres at 400 Paul Kruger Street in Pretoria Central. It became widely known in September 2018, when a fire broke out inside the building and three firefighters died while responding to the blaze, a tragedy that was widely reported across South Africa at the time.

In the years afterward, the building underwent extensive redevelopment and refurbishment, with property group Rebosis overseeing work to restore and upgrade the structure both internally and externally. The rebuild addressed both the fire damage and the building's broader condition, bringing it back into use as a modern commercial office property rather than leaving it vacant after the fire.

The Bank of Lisbon Building remains a notable Pretoria Central address on Paul Kruger Street, its redevelopment standing as one of the more visible rebuilding projects to follow a fire in the city's commercial core.

Batsumi Travel is a 100 percent black woman-owned, Level 1 B-BBEE travel agency based in Colbyn, Pretoria, offering IATA- and ASATA-accredited corporate and leisure travel management. The agency handles last-minute reservations and booking changes as well as detailed dream-destination holidays and corporate conferences, conceptualising customised solutions to suit a client's schedule and budget.

Its services include concierge support, visa assistance, inbound and outbound travel arrangements and flight reservations, built around a philosophy of operating with integrity and transparency. The agency says it believes in building mutually beneficial, long-term relationships with its clients rather than one-off bookings. It suits corporate clients who need group and VIP travel managed professionally, as well as leisure travellers planning a getaway, and the agency is based on Amos Street in Colbyn, Pretoria.

Bauba Resources is a diversified mining and exploration company based in Highveld, Centurion, listed on the JSE since September 2010. The group holds the Bauba Platinum Project in exploration and development in the Bushveld Igneous Complex, alongside chrome interests including the Moeijelijk Chrome Mine, the Kookfontein Chrome Project and the Naboom Chrome Mine.

The company says it is fully compliant with the equity requirements of the Mining Charter and embraces the transformation intent of the Minerals and Petroleum Resources Development Act and the Broad-Based Black Economic Empowerment Charter. Its health and safety policy is aligned with occupational health and mining legislation, with a stated goal of zero harm to employees, contractors and nearby communities, and its sites are rehabilitated in line with relevant legislation once mining activity ends. It suits investors and industry partners interested in a transformation-focused South African mining and exploration group, with its office on Tegel Avenue in Highveld.

BB GWM Haval Montana is a car dealership in Montana Park selling the full range of Great Wall Motors vehicles, including the GWM P-Series pickup and the eco-friendly GWM Ora, as part of the BB Motor Group. The dealership presents its range as suited to a variety of lifestyles, from tough pickup work to everyday urban commuting and weekend adventures.

Its team of experienced professionals guides buyers through the GWM model range to match a vehicle to their driving needs, and the dealership also handles used GWM vehicles, service and parts, and vehicle finance. Customers from Bela-Bela, Montana and across Gauteng are served from this location, with the latest models, dealership offers and after-sales services all available on site. It suits buyers in the north of Pretoria looking for a new or used GWM vehicle backed by local service, and the dealership is on Sefako Makgatho Drive in Montana Park.

Bearings International is an industrial parts supplier in Rosslyn, Akasia, with more than 60 years of experience and part of the Hudaco group. Its product range includes bearings and seals, chains and sprockets, electric motors and drives, gearboxes, couplings, belts and pulleys, and lubricants and tools, alongside a manufacturing capability for standard and purpose-built motor control panels and distribution boards.

Beyond supply, the company offers technical expertise and application engineering, engineering refurbishment and repairs, and field services, serving the mining, sugar, automotive, industrial, agriculture and FMCG sectors. Its stated purpose is to reduce downtime and keep industrial customers moving, since a stoppage for a client is a stoppage in its own business. It suits industrial operators and maintenance teams across several sectors who need parts, repairs and technical support in one place, and the branch is on Gaigher Street in Rosslyn.

items.description:
Blue Web Technologies is an IT company in Constantia Park, Pretoria, with more than 15 years of experience and an array of professional services including IT support, Microsoft Exchange hosted email, cloud backup, hosting and PBX/VoIP telephony. Its Exchange offering combines the benefits of cloud-based email with the robust capabilities of an on-premises server.

Its cloud backup is encrypted and compressed using the company's own proprietary backup features, while its hosting promises 99.9 percent uptime for domains, email and websites on performance servers. The company also provides wired and wireless networking solutions and supplies and installs CCTV equipment, and clients can manage support requests, SMS and file storage through its client portal, helpdesk and NextCloud services. It suits businesses that want to outsource their IT support and infrastructure to a single, established local provider, and the office is on Rover Road in Constantia Park.

Bluebell Hospitality Services provides hands-on operational support to guesthouses, lodges and boutique properties from its base in Centurion Golf Estate, helping them grow sustainably and professionally. Its core services include a central reservations office for managing day-to-day bookings, online listings management across platforms, and direct and social media marketing, all delivered on a monthly retainer with packages tailored to a property's needs.

The company operates as an extension of a client's own team, handling reservations, listings, marketing or admin so owners can focus on the guest experience, backed by regular reporting and ongoing strategy reviews. Among the properties it represents is an award-winning guesthouse in a peaceful, secure Sandton suburb with 45 well-equipped rooms. It suits independent guesthouse and lodge owners who want professional booking and marketing support without hiring an in-house team, and the business is on Canyon Close in Centurion Golf Estate.

Bo Fire Maintenance Services is a fire safety provider in Riviera, Pretoria, started in 2011 as part of the Centa Group and registered with both SAQCC and SABS. The company supplies, services and installs all types of fire equipment, along with fire and evacuation signage, positioning itself as a first choice for fire equipment and safety in the area.

Qualified and accredited technicians visit client premises to install and maintain fire detection systems in line with set fire standards, and every system is checked before installation to ensure safety comes first. The company also conducts fire risk assessments as part of its service offering. It suits businesses and property owners who need fire equipment supplied, installed and kept compliant with South African fire standards, and the business is on Annie Botha Avenue in Riviera, Pretoria.

items.description:
Bossa is a fast-casual restaurant and bar franchise with branches across South Africa and in Namibia, including this location at Castle Walk Shopping Centre in Erasmuskloof, Pretoria. The brand serves breakfast and lunch menus alongside dinner and drinks, with vegetarian-friendly options, a bar, takeaway and WiFi available at its branches.

Its positioning is as a relaxed venue to unwind after work, celebrate a birthday, enjoy a meal or sip a cocktail as the evening winds down, with a speciality coffee and a fireplace for the colder months. Branches operate across Gauteng, the Western Cape, the Free State, Mpumalanga and Namibia, so travelling guests can expect a similar menu and atmosphere at other Bossa locations. It suits families, groups and individuals looking for an all-day dining spot with a bar, and this branch trades from Nossob Street in Erasmuskloof.

BrainTrust Business Training is a fully accredited QCTO and Services SETA real estate training provider aligned with the Property Practitioners Regulatory Authority, offering the full suite of real estate qualifications and preparation courses. Since starting in 2009, the provider says it has serviced more than 10,000 students countrywide, with a strong retention rate and the fastest certification turnaround it claims in the industry.

Its Real Estate NQF 4 and 5 qualifications are PPRA requirements for anyone wishing to practise as a full status or principal estate agent, and the provider's team guides students through whichever path they choose. Alongside the core qualifications, it runs online and face-to-face CPD workshops that help agents gain their annual CPD points while adding value to their personal and professional development. It suits anyone entering the real estate industry or renewing their accreditation, and the business is based on Thomson Street in Colbyn, Pretoria.

items.description:
Brisen Commodities is a South African agricultural commodity trading company based in Lyttelton Manor, Centurion, with more than 30 years of industry presence. Its physical trading covers the procurement and marketing of maize, wheat, soybeans, sorghum and sunflower, using spot and forward contracting with flexible delivery structures such as ex-silo, ex-farm and mill-door.

The firm also provides SAFEX hedging strategies and brokerage services, price risk mitigation, grain financing solutions and cash flow optimisation support, backed by market commentary, data-driven insights and strategic trading guidance. It is a SAFEX registered trader and an associate member of AFMA, and it has built trusted relationships with producers, millers and traders nationwide through independent, commercially focused advice. It suits grain producers, millers and traders who need both physical trading and risk management expertise, and the company is based on River Road in Lyttelton Manor.

Buchel Homes and Paintcor ColourWays is a paint and home improvement supplier in Val-de-Grace, Pretoria, distributing a full range of colours, paints and accessories throughout South Africa. Its exterior and interior paint ranges are rated for 5, 7, 10 and 15 years of durability, and the shop also stocks roof coatings, wood coatings, industrial enamels and healthy goods formulations.

Beyond paint, the range covers brushware and abrasives, adhesives including Alcolin products, foams and fillers, silicone equipment and sealers, tapes and patches, and cleaning materials and solvents. Customers can select and compare colours online from an extensive set of colour cards and fan decks before having their order delivered anywhere in South Africa. It suits homeowners, painters and contractors who want a wide paint and hardware range matched to a specific durability rating, and the store is at the corner of Onida Avenue and Loepiet Street in Val-de-Grace.

Buffalo SA is an engineered retaining wall and civil infrastructure contractor based in Rietondale, Pretoria, with more than 33 years of experience and over 1,000 completed projects across South Africa. Its systems include concrete retaining walls, gabion wall systems, gravity retaining walls, segmental retaining walls and engineered reinforced soil structures, alongside plant rentals and concrete construction.

The company is NHBRC registered, carries public liability insurance, and builds to SANS engineering standards, with every wall engineered and constructed to protect people, property and infrastructure for decades. Its stated focus is on-time delivery, low-maintenance designs and long-lasting structural performance rather than simply selling a service. It suits developers, civil contractors and property owners needing engineered retaining structures, and the company operates from Lys Street in Rietondale with regional bases in Gauteng and the Western Cape.

Buku Office Supplies, trading as Valinor Trading 238, is a wholesaler and retailer of stationery, office furniture, printer cartridges and toners based in East Lynne, Pretoria. The business supplies office products and printing-related consumables to businesses, schools and government departments countrywide.

Its range covers everyday office stationery alongside office furniture and filing and storage systems, with cartridges and toners for standard office printers among its most requested lines. As a wholesaler, the business is set up to supply bulk and repeat orders for organisations that need a steady stationery supplier rather than a single retail purchase. It suits schools, government departments and businesses that need an established office supplies wholesaler, and the business is on Baviaanspoort Road in East Lynne.

Business Rescue is a Pretoria-based practice established in 2001, describing itself as South Africa's first dedicated business rescue company with 25 years of experience. It helps financially distressed companies with a straight assessment of whether rescue is realistic, and where the numbers support it, moves to protect the business from creditor action and keep it trading.

Its services cover applying for business rescue, structured debt management, CIPC application assistance, board resolution guidance, court application support, and developing and implementing a business rescue plan, including a moratorium on legal action and creditor negotiations toward realistic payment arrangements. The firm handles each case discreetly, since news that a company is in trouble can itself cost it customers, suppliers and staff, and it keeps directors, staff and creditors informed and treated fairly throughout the process. It suits company directors facing financial distress who need a clear, practical route forward, and the office is at Lady Brooks Office Park in Menlo Park, Pretoria.
